name: Razorpay
summary: Create orders, UPI and standard payment links, and QR codes; manage captures, refunds, and settlements.
description: Razorpay's official hosted MCP server over Streamable HTTP (https://mcp.razorpay.com/mcp), built in Bengaluru for Indian and Southeast Asian merchants. Supports OAuth 2.1 sign-in or merchant API credentials to create orders, payment links, QR codes, captures, and refunds.
author: Razorpay
